data.content: {"story_edits":{"acceptance_criteria":[{"op":"add","criterion":{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form with a stored Last Updated Date","when":"The user changes valid details and clicks save and the backend confirms the save","then":"The backend sets the task's Last Updated Date to the time of the save and leaves its Creation Date unchanged"}},{"op":"add","criterion":{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form with a stored Last Updated Date and the save is rejected or fails","when":"The user clicks save","then":"The stored Last Updated Date is unchanged"}}],"edge_cases":[],"definition_of_done":[{"op":"add","text":"Last Updated Date is set on every successful save and unchanged when a save fails"}]},"fixes":[{"finding":1,"revised_tasks":[{"task_key":"BE-put-task-endpoint-with-validation","description":"Add a PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint that saves edited task fields. It sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the save on every successful save and does not change the Creation Date. It rejects an empty title, a due date earlier than the creation date, and a title longer than 100 characters, and stores no changes when it rejects a request.","definition_of_done":[{"op":"add","text":"Every successful save sets Last Updated Date to the time of the save and leaves Creation Date unchanged"},{"op":"add","text":"A rejected save leaves Last Updated Date unchanged"}]},{"task_key":"BE-put-task-error-responses","definition_of_done":[{"op":"replace","number":3,"text":"An internal server or database error returns an error response and leaves no partial changes, including no change to Last Updated Date"}]},{"task_key":"QA-task-update-test-suite","definition_of_done":[{"op":"add","text":"Tests confirm that a successful save sets Last Updated Date and that a failed save leaves it unchanged"}]}]}]}
